server.name: finops-analytics-mcp
server.description: FinOps Dashboard Agent Analytics, Prompt Cache FinOps & AlphaEvolve Optimization Platform

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: CRITICAL: Always call this tool FIRST whenever the user asks to see, open, launch, or inspect the FinOps dashboard, FinOps and Tokenomics dashboard, FinOps MCP dashboard, or FinOps & Tokenomics Analytics Dashboard, or asks for the Gemini Enterprise agent fleet, agent telemetry, prompt cache economics, or AlphaEvolve optimization in the interactive UI. Opens the interactive dashboard in the side panel or full screen: every agent deployed on the Gemini Enterprise app with live Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging telemetry, plus the AlphaEvolve optimization studio.

initial_agent.description: Optional Gemini Enterprise agent to select: 'it_service_desk' (IT Service Desk), 'finops_analytics' (FinOps & Tokenomics Analytics), or 'deep_research' (Deep Research).

focus_tab.description: Tab to open: 6 = Overview (default), 0 = Agents, 3 = Cost, 4 = Users, 7 = Antigravity (Google Antigravity IDE seats, WTU allowance & PAYG). Advanced tabs: 1 = Goals & Metrics, 2 = Optimizer & Testing, 5 = Tools & SDK.

window_hours.description: Telemetry window for the live fleet in hours (1-720, default 24).

tools.name: query_project_telemetry
tools.description: Fetches live Google Cloud telemetry for the project hosting Cloud Run, including active Cloud Run agent microservices, BigQuery support logs from Gemini Enterprise apps, and structured usage_metadata prompt cache statistics from Cloud Logging.

force_refresh.description: If true, forces a re-sync from Google Cloud Logging.

tools.name: query_ge_agent_fleet
tools.description: Lists every agent deployed on the Gemini Enterprise app (ADK agents on Vertex AI Agent Engine, A2A agents, and Google-managed agents) with live telemetry aggregated from Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging: requests, 4xx/5xx errors, p50/p95 latency, LLM calls, input/output tokens, conversations, and last activity, plus project-wide Vertex AI model token usage and estimated cost.

window_hours.description: Telemetry window in hours (1-720, default 24; e.g. 1, 6, 24, 168).

force_refresh.description: If true, bypasses the 60-second cache and re-queries Google Cloud.

tools.name: calculate_prompt_cache_economics
tools.description: Calculates prompt cache hit ratio and net dollar savings vs naive rate cards for Google Cloud Gemini models (gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-1.5-flash, gemini-1.5-pro, gemini-3.1-flash).

cached_content_token_count.description: Number of tokens read from Gemini prompt cache.

output_token_count.description: Number of generated candidate tokens (defaults to 500).

tools.name: lint_agent_finops
tools.description: Runs the standalone FinOps AST Linter (FIN-01..FIN-05) on Python agent code and optionally runs the character-level Prompt Cache X-Ray & AlphaEvolve cache-friendly rewriter across two prompt turns.

code_snippet.description: Python source code of an ADK / Vertex AI / LangChain agent to scan for FinOps anti-patterns.

previous_prompt.description: Optional Turn N-1 prompt text for character-level Prompt Cache X-Ray.

current_prompt.description: Optional Turn N prompt text for character-level Prompt Cache X-Ray.

model.description: Model identifier for cache savings calculation (default 'gemini-2.5-flash').

tools.name: get_finops_state
tools.description: Retrieves full runtime state, active agent profile, recorded turns, and telemetry.
